title: SourceFreeze
description: Immutable snapshot of the Source Blackboard taken at Source-phase quiescence (the bridge artefact between the Source Blackboard and the Target Blackboard). Wave 9 introduced two Blackboard instances (SourceBlackboard, TargetBlackboard) of the same generic Blackboard class, connected by a SEQUENTIAL bridge: the SourceController runs its Activation -> Execution -> Conflict-Resolution loop until quiescence (or completion-predicate / max-iterations), then the engine freezes the Source Blackboard's panels into a SourceFreeze and starts the TargetController. SourceFreeze is the read-only typed projection that Target-phase KSs see via `controlContext.sourceFreeze()` (a `SourceFreezeView`). Persisted in `BundleStore` as a versioned artefact for replay (I-12).

freezeId.description: Engine-set unique id for this freeze artefact.

runId.description: Run id this SourceFreeze was produced by.

frozenAt.description: Wall-clock time of the freeze (set when SourceController declared quiescence).

sourcePackUris.description: Versioned gsmarc:// URIs of the Sourcing Packs whose KSs and panels populated the Source Blackboard.

abstractionLayers.description: Snapshot of the Pack-declared abstractionLayers in effect during the Source phase. Echoed for self-describing replay.

panels.description: Frozen panel snapshots. One entry per Source Blackboard panel. The `slots` map carries the resolved values per identity AND the full underlying Contribution log (so a Target KS may call either `resolved(panel, key)` or `contributionsOf(panel, key)` against the SourceFreezeView, mirroring the live Blackboard accessors).
